basis: Defined by dysfunction of the lower digestive tract.
Aphasia is impaired cerebral language function, specifically word retrieval.
Degeneration or inflammation of peripheral motor nerves; secondary weakness does not establish intrinsic muscle disease.
Sellar tumour umbrella includes pituitary endocrine neoplasms and CNS tumours such as craniopharyngioma and meningioma; visual damage is not universal.
Isolated sperm flagellar abnormalities and male infertility; no endocrine dysfunction or other covered organ disease established.
Cobalamin metabolic defect defined by megaloblastic anemia and neurodevelopmental disease; retinopathy 80–99%; cardiovascular abnormalities 30–79% omitted at cap.
Direct injury to brain tissue; manifestations depend on the location and severity of injury.
Permanent neonatal diabetes; motor/social developmental delay, athetosis and epileptiform activity in 1/1 annotated patient support neurologic involvement, with limited sampling.
Cerebellar atrophy, ataxia and developmental impairment; nystagmus and impaired pursuit are neurologic, and dysphagia does not establish intrinsic digestive damage.
Defined combined immunodeficiency; no common direct damage to another organ is established.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with abnormal sperm flagella and infertility; the gene alone does not establish respiratory ciliopathy.
Severe hypertension without acute target-organ damage by definition.
Peroxisomal disorder with rhizomelia, stippling and cataracts; neurodevelopmental impairment occurs in most typical cases; respiratory involvement omitted at cap.
ID, metaphyseal dysplasia and vascular telangiectasia define syndrome; optic atrophy in 2/2. GI bleeding (1/2) and hypothyroidism (1/1 assessed) omitted at cap.
Inherited haptocorrin transport deficiency usually causes low measured B12 without functional deficiency; common neurologic injury or anemia is not established.
CSRP3-related hypertrophic cardiomyopathy directly affects myocardium; reported arrhythmias remain within the cardiovascular axis.
Adenocarcinoma originates in uterine endometrium, a reproductive site outside the axes; estrogen association does not establish endocrine organ disease.
Inherited myopia is an ocular growth and refractive disorder.
Pontocerebellar and spinal motor-neuron disease; retinal dystrophy occurs in 5–29%; renal microangiopathy is not established as common. Weakness is neurogenic.
Progressive retinal photoreceptor degeneration; polydactyly in 2/6 (~33%) lacks established functional skeletal damage and is not added.
Metabolic bone disease caused by chronic fluoride accumulation, with skeletal remodeling and ligament calcification.
Defining malformations involve external ears, shortened phalanges and hypoplastic toenails; no additional covered organ damage is established.
Definition specifies MST1R-related nasopharyngeal carcinoma; the nasopharynx belongs to the pulmonary airway axis.
Benign familial megalencephaly with enlarged head/brain and possible ventriculomegaly; skull shape does not establish a separate skeletal disorder.
Inherited manganese metabolic disorder defined by dystonia; hepatic disease and polycythemia are subtype-dependent and not established across most of the umbrella.
